title: WPMS/847/2020 of RAJENDRA KANDPAL Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPMS No. 847 of 2020
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Ganesh Kandpal, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, Deputy Advocate General
with Ms. Anjali Bhargava, Brief Holder for the
State/respondents.
A motor road is being constructed known as
"Roonikhet to Gandhigram, Almora, Dungaragaon
Motor Road". The short case of the petitioner is that
the construction of this motor road is being done in
violation of the survey map and the road alignment is
not being followed, as a result of which some
agricultural land of the petitioner which was never
acquired is also coming in the construction area.
In this regard, the petitioner has moved a
representation dated 14.05.2019 before the Executive
Engineer, Provincial Division, Public Works
Department, Bageshwar.
The only prayer the learned counsel for the
petitioner is making at this point is that let direction
be given to respondent no. 2 to decide the
representation of the petitioner within a period of
three weeks from the date of production of a certified
copy of this order, after making proper inspection.
The prayer is not opposed by the State Counsel.
In fact the prayer seems to be just.
In view thereof, writ petition is disposed with
direction to respondent no. 3 i.e. Executive Engineer,
Provincial Division, Public Works Department,
Bageshwar to decide the pending representation of the
petitioner within three weeks from the date of
production of a certified copy of this order. It is made
clear that he shall pass speaking order after making
personal inspection of the affected area.
